segments.normalizedSource: ```swift do { // Activate the gaming slice before starting a multiplayer session. try await CTSlicingManager.shared.activatePreferredSliceForCategory(.gaming) // Establish network connections for gaming traffic. // New connections route through the gaming network slice. // Existing connections remain on their current routing. } catch POSIXError.ENOTSUP { print("Network slicing isn't currently available.") } catch { print("Failed to activate slice: \(error)") } ```
